references.title: DWDS: nur
references.supports: Adverb with no Wortzerlegung; Etymologie: the word arises 'durch Verkürzung' of an older phrase

references.title: en.wiktionary: nur
references.supports: German etymology: contracted from MHG niwer, newære, from OHG ni wāri 'were it not'

notes.rationale: nur Friedrich und Rollo folgten, 'only'. Its old source, ni wāri, is contracted beyond any cut, and DWDS gives no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word, an indeclinable one with no Ending (ADR 0051): the Root nur alone.
